verdict.reason: This function is sensitive because it directly modifies image metadata associated with user photos. This falls under Type 5 (Access Transparency Consent and Control - Photos) as it operates on sensitive data associated with photos, and Type 1 (File and File System Operations) as modifying photo metadata is a form of writing to user files (or data directly derived from them).
